name: Chinese Maritime Transport Ltd.
summary: Chinese Maritime Transport Ltd. is a diversified logistics and shipping company with a global footprint, operating across Asia, the United States, Europe, and Oceania. The company specializes in bulk carrier operations and integrated inland container transportation and terminal services. Its extensive offerings encompass the ownership and management of bulk vessels, bulk chartering, terminal operations, manufacturing, technology ventures, and other investment activities. Its comprehensive container trucking services include long- and short-haul drayage, shipside, dock, and port container trans-loading, coordination for customer container freight stations (CFS) and container yards (CY), and door-to-door delivery. They also provide real-time container status updates and inspection services. Furthermore, the company manages fully-owned container yards and depots, offering empty-container storage, cleaning, repair, and a range of other logistic support. Beyond this, their services extend to general container yard (CY) and freight station (CFS) operations, inbound/outbound handling (IB/OB), container maintenance and repair, reefer container services, bonded and chilled warehouse facilities, empty container depots, and outside unbonded warehouses, along with customs cargo closing. They also supply labor for tasks such as labeling, sorting, picking, delivery, and barcode scanning. Additionally, the company diversifies into aviation and travel, serving as the sales agent for Saudi Arabian Airlines in Taiwan. This includes services for cargo freighter charters, general air cargo, passenger and ticket agency operations, travel planning, reservation services, and complete travel packages. Established in 1946, originally under the name Associated Transport Inc., Chinese Maritime Transport Ltd. is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
